About Kijani Grace

Kijani Grace School is a post-modern school located along Kamiti Road at Richland Estate. We help each learner read their own compass, trust it, and follow it with confidence.

In bright classrooms, open courtyards and a community that knows every child by name, learners grow into the people they are meant to be.

What guides us

  1. 01

    Direction

    Clear guidance that helps each learner see where they are going.

  2. 02

    Character

    Grace, respect and honesty in how we learn and how we treat each other.

  3. 03

    Community

    Families, teachers and learners walking the same road together.
